painPoints.heading: Struggling to Keep Your Website Current?
painPoints.text: When your product is constantly evolving, it's often difficult to keep the website up-to-date while maintaining the highest design standards.

painPoints.heading: Unhappy with the Current Design/Structure?
painPoints.text: If you're fully focused on the product, your website can become unstructured over time, which also affects the design.

painPoints.heading: No Budget for a Dedicated In-House Team?
painPoints.text: Great designers and developers are expensive. Who can afford to hire A-players to work on their product's website?

trust.heading:
Focus on Your Product –
We'll Handle the Website
trust.text: We take care of the design of your high-end website, including graphics, animations, and documentation pages. And we implement it with modern frontend technologies – no Webflow, no Framer.

targets.heading: Outperform the Competition
targets.text: Your perfectly designed website will elevate your SaaS to the level of big players like Linear or Stripe.

targets.heading: Generate More Users or Waitlist Signups
targets.text: Great landing pages appeal more to potential users and bring you attention on Twitter, ProductHunt, etc.

targets.heading: Your Website Grows Magically with the Product
targets.text: While you develop new product features, we take care of the associated feature pages on your website.

steps.heading: Subscribe & Make Requests
steps.text: Subscribe in just a minute and gain access to your own request board. There, you'll initially find tips on how to get the most out of your subscription. When you're ready for a top-tier website, make as many requests as you'd like – we work on them one by one.

steps.heading: Design & Development
steps.text: We'll take care of your active request today or tomorrow (business days only, of course). You'll receive a notification when we're finished – usually, it takes about 48 hours for design requests and about 96 hours for development requests. This may vary slightly depending on the scope of the request.

steps.heading: Optimization & Expansion
steps.text: Once a request is processed, you can provide feedback. We'll revise the result until you're 100% satisfied. As you develop new features for your product, simply write new requests to have the features added to the website or have entire feature pages created. This way, your website grows magically with your product.

design.heading:
Cutting-Edge Design,
Specifically for Your SaaS Product
design.text: We place great importance on exceptional design as we know it not only attracts more potential users but can also generate significant social media attention for your product. Our design process has been optimized for collaboration with Figma, allowing you to easily view previews and prototypes.

categories.heading:
Compelling Landing &
Feature Pages
categories.text: With great, conversion-optimized landing pages, your potential users will understand why they need your product and be motivated to sign up.

categories.heading:
Beautifully Composed
Graphics & Animations
categories.text: Show, don't tell: To clearly explain your product and its benefits, we need high-quality graphics and animations on your website.

categories.heading:
Clear
Documentation Pages
categories.text: Structuring and building documentation pages can be challenging. We'll find the best way to design and build your docs.

development.heading:
No Webflow, No Framer,
But True Next.js Development
development.text: Yes, low-code website builders are great for quickly creating a landing page. But we believe nothing beats a modern frontend stack in the long run. This gives us full control over design and animations and, most importantly, the ability to fully integrate services like payments, CMS, search, bookings, etc.

call.heading: Unsure of What's Right?
call.text: We offer premium services that aren't affordable for everyone. If you're not sure if our service fits your company or product, feel free to book a call with our founder, Lukas.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: We always want to be 100% open and transparent with our services. If anything is still unclear, feel free to book a call with our founder, Lukas.

questions.a: No – you can add as many requests to your board as you want. However, we only work on one active request at a time.

questions.q: What kind of designs are included?
questions.a: Everything related to your website. This typically includes the UI, graphics, icons, and illustrations. If you don't have branding yet, we can take care of that too.

questions.q: What tech stack do you use?
questions.a: Your website will fundamentally be implemented with Next.js and TailwindCSS. We believe a modern stack provides the best foundation for future updates or additions.
Sure. We can basically integrate anything that has an API. For example, we often work with payment providers, CMS, search, and Google services.

questions.q: Do you also develop our product?
questions.a: No. Developing a product takes a lot of time and dedication. Our passion is building great websites. Therefore, we take care of everything website-related so you can focus on building the best product for your users.

questions.q: Why not just hire a full-time employee?
questions.a: We offer these services because we know how hard it is to find A-players and how expensive it is to hire them full-time. Our subscription is a cheaper and more flexible solution for building a world-class website for your product.

questions.q: What sets you apart from similar services?
questions.a: There are currently many subscription-based agencies – which is good, as the subscription model is a win for everyone. We're the first service to offer top-tier design and professional development instead of Webflow/Framer.
